headline: Argentina introduces tax innocence regulations and penalty reductions
summary: Argentina published new fiscal regulations allowing taxpayers to adhere to the system without previous turnover or declared asset limits, while reducing penalties.
why: Fiscal amnesties and tax regulatory updates impact corporate tax compliance liabilities, capital repatriation, and domestic investment liquidity.

impacts.name: Argentina
impacts.why: New tax provisions remove previous billing and asset caps for adherence.
